config.about: Zipursky lab optic-lobe time course (Kurmangaliyev et al.; devstages/_h5ad/Zipursky_*update.h5ad), 0 h to 96 h APF, W1118 and DGRP lines. Cell type = MultiomeAnnotated (label transfer to the multiome atlas); the authors' own type/subtype and class are kept. Stored tSNEs are empty, so a UMAP was computed here for each file (2,000 HVGs, 50 PCs; 0 h and 12 h share one); split by time. Genes = those present in every file.
